neighbors.title: Efficient multimodal large language models: a survey

neighbors.title: On the interplay of loop caching, code compression, and cache configuration

neighbors.title: A Survey of Resource-efficient LLM and Multimodal Foundation Models
neighbors.abstract: Large foundation models, including large language models (LLMs), vision transformers (ViTs), diffusion, and LLM-based multimodal models, are revolutionizing the entire machine learning lifecycle, from training to deployment. To support the growth of these large models in a scalable and environmentally sustainable way, there has been a considerable focus on developing resource-efficient strategies. neighbors.title: Adaptive Inference: Theoretical Limits and Unexplored Opportunities
neighbors.abstract: This paper introduces the first theoretical framework for quantifying the efficiency and performance gain opportunity size of adaptive inference algorithms.
